basic_info.name: Agustar Alfonso
basic_info.location: Kecamatan Cikarang Selatan, West Java, Indonesia
basic_info.summary:
I'm a Full-Stack & AI Engineer at Global Collabo Tech (Minori Group), where I build AI-powered products end to end, from the AI and backend services to the web and mobile apps people use.
I like owning a feature from start to finish: understanding the problem, writing the spec, building it across the stack, testing it and seeing it through to release. I care about products that work reliably for real users, not just in a demo.
I graduated in Informatics Engineering from UIN Sultan Syarif Kasim Riau (GPA 3.76). For my thesis, I fine-tuned an IndoBERT model for emotion classification in Indonesian song lyrics, published in a SINTA 3 journal. I also guided students through practicums as a laboratory assistant.
Tools I work with most: Python, TypeScript, FastAPI, Next.js, React Native, Flutter, PostgreSQL, Docker and cloud platforms such as Google Cloud.

case_study.summary: Undergraduate thesis: emotion classification of Indonesian song lyrics with a fine-tuned IndoBERT.
case_study.problem: Classifying emotion in Indonesian song lyrics, a low-resource setting for NLP.
built: Compiled a dataset of 1,025 labeled lyric entries covering four emotions: joy, sadness, fear and anger.
Fine-tuned and evaluated IndoBERT-base-p2 for emotion classification.
case_study.result: Best configuration reached 75.73% accuracy and 75.85% macro-averaged F1-score; published in the SINTECHCOM journal (SINTA 3).

case_study.summary: Real-time hand-gesture rock-paper-scissors game in the browser.
case_study.problem: Make a classic game playable with just a webcam, alone or against a friend.
built: Built a web-based rock-paper-scissors game with real-time hand gesture recognition using computer vision (MediaPipe Hands), supporting both live webcam input and image upload.
Implemented a real-time multiplayer mode powered by Firebase (room codes, shareable links, live dual gesture detection) alongside a single-player mode against AI.
Applied a modular architecture (game logic, multiplayer, navigation, gesture detection) to keep the codebase maintainable and scalable.

publications.title: An IndoBERT-based Framework for Emotion Classification in Indonesian Song Lyrics
publications.publisher: SINTECHCOM: Science, Technology and Communication Journal
bullets: Developed and evaluated an emotion classification model for Indonesian song lyrics using fine-tuned IndoBERT-base-p2.
Compiled a dataset of 1,025 labeled lyric entries covering four emotion categories: joy, sadness, fear, and anger.
Best model configuration achieved 75.73% accuracy and 75.85% macro-averaged F1-score.
